parameters.formDescription: Generate a concise research brief from up to five web search results. Use public, non-confidential topics only. Report usually takes a short time; provider rate limits can delay or prevent completion.

values.placeholder: Example: What practical methods reduce water use in data centres? Explain trade-offs and evidence.

nodes.name: Research Topic Form
nodes.notes: Input must be a public, non-confidential question. Code node enforces 20-300 characters after trimming.

nodes.name: Validate Input + Start Clock
nodes.notes: Local input validation and start timestamps. No API calls here.

nodes.name: Build Input Error Page
nodes.notes: Render escaped HTML; invalid requests do not consume API quota.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { query: $json.topic, topic: 'general', search_depth: 'basic', chunks_per_source: 1, max_results: 5, include_published_date: true, include_answer: false, include_raw_content: false, include_images: false, include_usage: false, safe_search: false } }}

nodes.name: Tavily Basic Search
nodes.notes: Select a Header Auth credential with Authorization: Bearer <Tavily token>. Max 5 basic results; request timeout 15s; 3 attempts total with 5s backoff. Error output routes to a truthful failure page.

nodes.name: Normalize & Deduplicate Sources
nodes.notes: Accept HTTP(S) URLs only; deduplicate URL; at most five sources; snippets and complete evidence JSON capped to 6,000 characters. No crawl or extra search.

nodes.name: Build No-Results Page
nodes.notes: No Gemini call when no valid source is available.

nodes.name: Gemini Flash-Lite Synthesis
nodes.notes: Select Header Auth credential x-goog-api-key: <Google AI Studio key>. Uses stable model gemini-3.5-flash-lite, which defaults to minimal thinking for low latency. Uses structured JSON output; deprecated sampling parameters are intentionally omitted. Request timeout 30s; 3 attempts total, then explicit failure page.

nodes.name: Validate Citations + Render Report
nodes.notes: Reject malformed/truncated output. Validate IDs against retrieved sources; use API-returned URLs only. Unknown IDs or non-3-to-5 finding counts produce NEEDS_REVIEW. Escape all model/source text before HTML rendering.

nodes.name: Build Search Failure Page
nodes.notes: Maps auth, quota/rate-limit, timeout, and generic provider failure to actionable states. Does not expose raw provider error details.

nodes.name: Build Gemini Failure Page
nodes.notes: Handles exhausted Gemini retries without reporting false success. Quota failures instruct the operator to wait/check usage rather than retry infinitely.

nodes.name: Show Final Result
nodes.notes: All success and handled exception paths end here. HTML is generated with escaped text by local Code nodes.
